issue_context.title: Right-clicking with copied tiles will still place them
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

69a194f

### System information

W10

### Issue description

Technically this is not a bug, because it might be intended, but when you right-click with pasted tiles, the tiles will still be placed. This is not an expected behavior.
![gGAUNTnuOC](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/143793811-5048e20d-fb47-45ec-ab81-090507b2cb39.gif)
Right click should instead cancel the operation without drawing tiles.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Draw some tiles on TileMap
2. Select them
3. Ctrl + C
4. Ctrl + V
5. Right-click

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_
